name: All four assessment detail pages render their result types
description: Navigating through each of the four assessment detail pages via the 'Explore other assessments' links shows each page's title and its full set of named result types.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Solstice assessment detail page

Verify the page heading shows 'The Solstice Cycle Assessment' and a 'Result outcomes' section lists the four season result types Summer, Autumn, Winter, and Spring, each with an emoji and a description.
Under 'Explore other assessments', click the Turing link
Verify the Turing page heading shows 'The Modes of Mind Assessment' and its 'Result outcomes' section lists the four modes The Integrator, The Logician, The Reader, and The Operator.
Under 'Explore other assessments', click the Pride link
Verify the Pride page heading shows 'The Spectrum of Self Assessment' and its 'Result outcomes' section lists The Beacon, The Prism, The Ember, and The Aurora.
Under 'Explore other assessments', click the Passage link
Verify the Passage page heading shows 'The Passage of Time Assessment' and its 'Result outcomes' section lists at least these temporal types: The Keeper, The Witness, The Wayfinder, and Balanced.
